title: Mosque-madrasa of Sultan Hasan, Cairo
summary: Built from 1356 to about 1363 for the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Hasan beside the Citadel in Cairo, this mosque, madrasa and tomb is among the largest medieval Islamic buildings in Egypt. Its north facade is about 145 m long and 38 m high, and its southern minaret rises 81.6 m.

uncertainty.note: Sources differ on the end: Asharq Al-Awsat gives 1363, the museum catalogue gives completion of the mausoleum in AH 764 / AD 1362; Sultan Hasan died in 1361 with the work almost complete.
